title: Wigner symmetries single out symmetric Wasserstein distances in all finite dimensions
summary: We study the quantum Wasserstein distances of De Palma and Trevisan associated with quadratic costs generated by self-adjoint observables in arbitrary finite dimension. We first show that any positive semidefinite cost operator is determined by the corresponding distance on pairs of pure states. For nonzero observable-generated quadratic costs, we then prove that the full isometry monoid consists exactly of unitary and antiunitary conjugations if and only if the distance is invariant under unitary conjugations on pure states.
